findings.title: Every paginated page's Seer summary includes all error events of the replay
findings.body: The endpoint paginates over recording segments and calls analyze_recording_segments once per page, passing the replay-wide error_events list each time. gen_request_data restarts error_idx at 0 for every page, and this trailing loop yields every error not yet consumed. Each page's Seer request therefore contains every error in the replay, including errors whose timestamps fall in other pages, so the same errors are repeated across page summaries. The new tests only exercise a single page with one error, so they pass despite this.

findings.title: Error IDs are paired with nodestore results by position, not by key
findings.body: nodestore.backend.get_multi returns a mapping keyed by node id that omits missing nodes, and its order is not guaranteed to match error_ids. zip(error_ids, events.values()) pairs each error id with whatever value comes next in the mapping. When any error's nodestore entry is missing (for example after retention expiry), every later error gets the title, message and timestamp of a different event. The 'data is not None' filter runs after the misalignment, so it does not prevent this. Each id should be looked up in the returned mapping.

findings.title: Exceptions from blob deletes are silently discarded
findings.body: pool.map returns a lazy iterator and its result is never consumed, so any exception raised by storage_kv.delete other than NotFound is never re-raised. The with-block only waits for completion. A failed blob delete (permissions, network error) produces no log or metric, and delete_replays then archives the replay anyway, leaving orphaned recording blobs with no trace. Consume the results (for example list(pool.map(...))) or submit futures and check their exceptions. This is pre-existing, but it is in a file this PR touches.

findings.title: Feature-flagged table path renders hard-coded empty data and ignores query results
findings.body: When the use-table-widget-visualization flag is enabled, each table widget is replaced by TableWidgetVisualization with columns set to an empty array and tableData hard-coded to empty data. This ignores tableResults, loading, result.meta, the custom field renderer and minTableColumnWidth. Any organization with the flag sees empty tables for every table widget. This looks like scaffolding and should not ship in this form.

findings.title: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES is only applied when a search query is entered
findings.body: The early return when searchQuery is empty returns the sorted list without applying the HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES filter. The filter only runs when the user types a search. With the default empty search, is_segment, project_id and received are shown, but they disappear as soon as any search is typed. The hidden-attribute rule should apply in both cases.

findings.title: Comment points to a replacement migration that is not part of this change
findings.body: The no-op body says the correct migration is 0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised.py, but no such file appears in the changed files. 0917 and 0920 are both replaced with no-ops, and the 0917 test is deleted. If the replacement is not in this PR, org-level saved searches will never be converted into GroupSearchView rows, and the comment misleads readers. Either add the replacement or correct the reference.

findings.title: Summary card renders with empty content when the API returns no summary
findings.body: useFeedbackSummary returns summary as string or null. tooFewFeedbacks is only true when numFeedbacksUsed is 0 and success is false. If feedbacks were used but the LLM call failed (success false, summary null), this component still renders the 'Feedback Summary' header with an empty paragraph. The component should return null when summary is null.

findings.title: Unescaped issue title is placed inside a markdown link in PR comments
findings.body: The template renders '[**{title}**]({url})' with the raw issue title. Titles derive from error messages, which can be influenced by application input. A title containing ']' followed by '(' closes the link text early and lets the remaining text form an arbitrary link destination in a comment the Sentry bot posts on the PR. The environment name is also interpolated raw inside backticks. The title should be escaped or sanitized before interpolation.

findings.title: Recommended event is loaded from nodestore for every issue in every PR comment
findings.body: get_environment_info calls issue.get_recommended_event() and then get_environment() for each of up to five issues per comment. Each call does a nodestore fetch and a DB lookup, and this runs on every PR comment build. The environment could be fetched in a batch, or cached per issue.

findings.title: Title truncation and environment formatting have no test coverage
findings.body: The new _truncate_title path (titles longer than 50 characters get an ellipsis) and the non-empty environment suffix in get_environment_info are not exercised by the GitHub or GitLab PR comment tests. The existing tests use short titles and only check the happy path. A regression in truncation or the environment suffix would not be caught.

findings.title: Validation no longer requires timestamp or age; truthiness checks skip 0 values
findings.body: The previous dataclass required timestamp, but both age and timestamp are now optional, so a report with neither field validates. The mutual-exclusion validators use truthiness on initial_data, so age 0 or timestamp 0 combined with the other field is accepted. The checks should test for key presence and the presence of one field should be required.

findings.title: Assemble analytics event is recorded before the feature-flag gate
findings.body: analytics.record runs before features.has(...). Requests from organizations without the preprod-artifact-assemble feature, which receive a 404, still emit preprod_artifact.api.assemble events. This pollutes the metric with traffic from non-enrolled orgs. The record call should move below the feature check.

findings.title: Default autofix tuning changed from low to off for every project without an explicit setting
findings.body: Changing DEFAULT_AUTOFIX_AUTOMATION_TUNING_DEFAULT (and the matching projectoptions default) to off changes live behavior for every project that never set sentry:autofix_automation_tuning, with no migration, backfill or release note. The tests were only updated to match the new default. This should be called out explicitly or handled with a data migration.

findings.title: Environment filter silently dropped from the attribute keys request
findings.body: The previous useTraceItemAttributeKeys sent environment: selection.environments to the trace-items attributes endpoint. The new makeTraceItemAttributeKeysQueryOptions omits it and says it is intentionally unsupported, which contradicts the prior behavior. Attribute keys from every environment are now returned, which is a silent behavior change.

findings.title: Analytics event name changed, breaking continuity of the View HTML metric
findings.body: The trackAnalytics call for the View HTML click was renamed from replay.view_html to replay.view-html. Existing dashboards and queries keyed on the old name will stop receiving data for this action. The rename should be noted, or the old name kept for continuity.

findings.title: Snuba query and nodestore fetch run on every page request, even when error context is disabled
findings.body: The endpoint runs query_replay_instance and fetch_error_details before paginate, so both run on every paginated request, not once per replay. The Snuba query also runs when enable_error_context=false, where its result is discarded except for error_ids that are then ignored. Error details should be fetched once per replay or skipped when disabled.
